changelog:
Testing Build (vc18-0210) vs Testing Build (vc19-0210)

Fixes
- Container logs (Overview): the log view now follows the newest line - it
  opens at the bottom and keeps sticking to it on every update, but only while
  you are already at the bottom (scrolling up to read history is never
  interrupted). The last line gets bottom breathing room instead of being
  clipped against the border.
- Login footer: "Powered by ANDREBARRETOIT" now renders on its own line below
  the version.

Changes
- Version display is split into Channel and PatchFix on the Update page and
  About (e.g. "Channel: Testing Build · PatchFix: vc19-0210"); the footers use
  the short form "Testing Build (vc19-0210)". PatchFix carries the build date
  (DDMM) of that release and never changes afterwards - a build from 02/10
  keeps showing -0210 forever, even a year later without updating.
- Managed by card (child side): now shows the manager device model next to the
  server name; full details (kernel, CPU, memory, battery, uptime, images)
  remain in the detail pane on click.
- Release changelogs are now formatted with sections and line breaks instead of
  a single paragraph (the panel update page renders them with line breaks).
